They also require the solution to enable communication with several [product_name] PLCs at once. The query suggests that there is insufficient documentation or support for integrating [product_name] with OPC in these scenarios, particularly when using existing [company_name] OPC software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a clear, step-by-step guide to configure OPC connectivity between [product_name] modules and their PC using SOFTNET S7 LEAN, as well as ensuring that the setup accommodates communication with multiple [product_name] PLCs simultaneously.
